description: This file contains unit tests for the TextFragment and TextSegmentIterator classes in the WPEFramework Core library. It uses Google Test framework to verify functionalities such as string manipulation, iteration, comparison, trimming, and searching within text fragments.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a segment of text with methods for manipulation and comparison.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing segments within a TextFragment based on delimiters.

methods.name: TextFragment(string)
methods.description: Constructor initializing TextFragment from a string.

methods.name: TextFragment(string, int, int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing TextFragment with specific offset and length.

methods.name: Remainder()
methods.description: Returns the remaining part of the text fragment.

methods.name: Current()
methods.description: Returns the current segment in iteration.

methods.name: ForwardFind()
methods.description: Finds a delimiter in the text fragment.

methods.name: OnMarker()
methods.description: Checks if a marker exists in the text fragment.

methods.name: EqualText()
methods.description: Checks if the text fragment equals given text.

methods.name: TrimBegin()
methods.description: Removes a prefix from the text fragment.

methods.name: TrimEnd()
methods.description: Removes a suffix from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReverseFind()
methods.description: Finds a substring starting from the end.
